description: Runtime wiring backlog for heuristic/advisory/sidecar surfaces that still affect production-readiness

backlog.notes: Semantic seed-tag extraction and diffusion augmentation selection still rely on keyword/rule paths when governed hypotheses are thin. Replace keyword-first routing with evidence/branch-value-conditioned proposal selection and keep stub rendering strictly behind explicit gating.

Passthrough SceneTracks currently marks some metadata as non-stub before later benchmark gating rejects it. Tighten these early summaries so replay/import/readiness surfaces never overstate grounding quality.

Replay queue selection is wired into live training and online SAC, but the core scoring remains rule-based. Promote the learned semantic/runtime scorer package into this bounded queue lane once replay coverage is broad enough.

backlog.blocked_by: packet-native datapack selection features and more real runtime outcomes
backlog.notes: Semantic scenario/datapack selection still uses tag matching and ARH penalties. Replace this with learned bounded routing over the same packet/evidence shape after the runtime corpus contains enough grounded selection outcomes.
